title: The tool is easy to set up and the team picked it up quickly
comments: Some features are hidden behind higher pricing tiers. Search and organisation get harder as the workspace grows. Support responded reasonably quickly to a question about permissions. Integrations with other tools mostly work but need occasional fixing. The mobile experience is weaker than the desktop one. The tool is easy to set up and the team picked it up quickly.
